import subprocess
from collections import Counter
seqs={}
for line in open('read.proportions.q1.fa'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'): h=line[1:].split()[0]; seqs[h]=''
    else: seqs[h]+=line.upper()
chroms=list(seqs); patterns=Counter(); skipped=Counter()
p=subprocess.Popen(['bwa','samse','-n','20','read.proportions.q1.fa','read.proportions.q1.sai','read.proportions.q1.fq.gz'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True)
for line in p.stdout:
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    f=line.rstrip().split('\\t'); flag=int(f[1]); cigar=f[5]
    if flag&4: skipped['unmapped']+=1; continue
    if cigar"'!='"'36M': skipped[cigar]+=1; continue
    pos=int(f[3])-1; read=f[9].upper()
    d=tuple(sum(a"'!=b for a,b in zip(read,seqs[c][pos:pos+36])) for c in chroms)
    patterns[d]+=1
p.wait(); n=sum(patterns.values())
print('"'used',n,'skipped',dict(skipped),flush=True)
for pat,num in patterns.most_common(20): print(pat,num,flush=True)
for e in [.002,.005,.008,.01,.02,.03,.05]:

            ws=[pi[k]*(ratio**d[k]) for k in range(4)]; z=sum(ws)

/bin/bash -lc "python -u - <<'PY'
import subprocess, numpy as np
from collections import Counter
seqs={}
for line in open('read.proportions.q1.fa'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'): h=line[1:].split()[0]; seqs[h]=''
    else: seqs[h]+=line.upper()
cs=list(seqs); L=len(seqs[cs[0]]); bases='ACGT'; bi={b:i for i,b in enumerate(bases)}
counts=np.zeros((L,4),dtype=int)
p=subprocess.Popen(['bwa','samse','-n','20','read.proportions.q1.fa','read.proportions.q1.sai','read.proportions.q1.fq.gz'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True)
used=0
for line in p.stdout:
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    f=line.rstrip().split('\\t')
    if int(f[1])&4 or f[5]"'!='"'36M': continue
    pos=int(f[3])-1
    for j,b in enumerate(f[9].upper()):
        if b in bi and 0<=pos+j<L: counts[pos+j,bi[b]]+=1
    used+=1
p.wait()
rows=[]; ys=[]; vars=0
pat=Counter()
for i in range(L):
    alleles=tuple(seqs[c][i] for c in cs); pat[alleles]+=1
    if len(set(alleles))==1 or counts[i].sum()==0: continue
    vars+=1; freq=counts[i]/counts[i].sum()
    for b in bases:
        rows.append([1.0 if alleles[k]==b else 0.0 for k in range(4)])
        ys.append(freq[bi[b]])
A=np.asarray(rows); y=np.asarray(ys)
# sum constraint included already per site but append precision constraint
A2=np.vstack([A, np.ones((20,4))]); y2=np.r_[y,np.ones(20)]
pi=np.linalg.lstsq(A2,y2,rcond=None)[0]
print('used',used,'variable sites',vars,'pi percent',pi*100,'sum',pi.sum())
print('genome allele patterns')
for x,n in pat.most_common():
    if len(set(x))>1: print(''.join(x),n)
PY"
